# Mcfly Ads — citeable summary

> Shopify app: see ad spend next to sales, day by day. Total ROAS = sales ÷ spend. 7-day trial then $39/store/mo.

## Product (Shopify)

Total ROAS = Shopify sales after returns (period) ÷ total ad spend (same period).
Break-even Total ROAS ≈ 1 ÷ contribution margin.
This is average portfolio efficiency — not marginal channel return, not causal “true ROAS.”
Monday Close / Export memo: exceptions → save → variance → decision (hold / reduce / step-test with spend floor) → CSV export.
Pricing: 7-day full-access trial, then $39/store/mo flat via Shopify Billing. Not a GMV tax. Uninstall stops the charge.
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/ · https://mcflyads.com/product · https://mcflyads.com/demo · https://mcflyads.com/monday-close · https://mcflyads.com/mer-calculator · https://mcflyads.com/break-even-roas-calculator · https://mcflyads.com/pricing

## Method / refuse

Platforms over-claim conversions. Mcfly measures money spent on ads vs sales in the same period.
We do not ship: pixels, multi-touch attribution, path/view-through credit, “true ROAS,” or attribution-suite clones.
Coexists with attribution suites for CYA path decks; owns the Export memo / Monday Close so suites become optional Monday software.
Authority: https://mcflyads.com/why-pixels-fail · https://mcflyads.com/faq · https://mcflyads.com/cash-mer · https://mcflyads.com/about · https://mcflyads.com/security
